_help: Edit this list to add/remove stocks. 'query' is what we search on Google News. 'aliases' are words that must appear in a headline to tag it (case-insensitive, whole word). Prefix an alias with '=' to make it case-sensitive (useful for short tickers like =ITC). 'group' lets you filter by business group on the dashboard. 'indices' drives the Nifty 50 / Sensex filter; a stock outside both can use [] or your own label like "Watchlist". 'core' stocks are searched on Google News every run; the rest are searched in rotation (each one about every 30 minutes in market hours). Regenerate with tools/build_watchlist.py.
